cause: 0.3.38 translated only seven header dates (three before, today, three after) while the row moved 45.5 logical px/hour. At 00:00 the first card began near x=619, leaving about 615 px blank at the left; at 06:00 it began near x=346, leaving about 342 px; at 18:00 the drawn strip ended near x=893, leaving about 195 px at the right; at 23:59 it ended near x=621, leaving about 467 px. The blank space came from missing chronological cards, not a change in card geometry or timeline scale.

solution.range: Model 16 local civil dates: eight before today, today, and seven after. Paint only cards intersecting the visible canvas interior, while retaining today in the model as the temporal anchor when it is fully offscreen.
solution.cardGeometry: Keep the original seven-card width/gap formula (154.9468 px card, 1.2287 px gap on the 1092 px logical canvas). No horizontal rescaling or re-centering.
solution.anchorAndSpeed: The selected card keeps x + 4 = temporal.midnightX. All cards use the existing lower timeline clock and move 45.5 logical px/hour. Date labels advance through addDays local-civil arithmetic at local midnight.
solution.alignment: Only the first visible card aligns its two rows to the right and the last visible card aligns to the left; interior visible cards stay centered. This is based on viewport position, not weekday.
solution.data: Keep EventKit reads within their existing seven-day schedule span. Increase Open-Meteo past_days and weather-hour retention from six/seven to eight preceding days so the newly visible header dates can use cached/provider weather. Extend automatic-holiday year coverage to the expanded header range.
solution.clipping: Canvas coordinates remain complete. Offscreen cards are not painted; cards crossing the widget contour use the existing outer clipping path. The today frame remains one continuous six-pixel path, with eight-pixel dividers/rings unchanged.
